description: Complete minimal subtype registry for Blackbox vNext reference implementation. Each registered subtype machine-defines: allowed core type(s), allowed receipt_class(es), semantic (state_transition|support|non_state), parent rule/cardinality, genesis_allowed. Invalid type/subtype/receipt_class combination => invalid receipt (NOT UNCLASSIFIED; UNCLASSIFIED reserved for unregistered subtype). Materialized from Design v0.1.4 D.3.

reclassify.notes: Append-only corrective record. References original UNCLASSIFIED via prior_refs.supports + extensions.x_reclassifies. Only the associated replacement event participates in fold.

resolution.notes: Names all conflicting heads in prior_refs.parent; produces new resolved head.

reconciliation.notes: May create genesis recorded head for orphan subject (zero parent) when no prior canonical head exists; otherwise references current head. Binds actual observed post-state + observed_at/recorded_at/reason; does not retroactively fabricate authorization/verification.

untagged_subtype_semantics: UNCLASSIFIED / no-effect (event retained for historical evidence only, cannot participate in effect eligibility or fold until reclassify path produces a registered-type/subtype replacement).
invalid_combination_semantics: If type/subtype/receipt_class is registered but the combination is not in this registry's allowed_type x allowed_receipt_class, the event is an invalid receipt (not UNCLASSIFIED).
